publications.name: Mobile robot inspection of building plenum spaces via vision-based multi-sensor fault detection
publications.summary: A mobile robotic inspection method combines semantic segmentation and object tracking with geometric and thermal features. Tests on data collected from building plenum spaces evaluate detection robustness under occlusion, sensor noise, and environmental variation.

publications.name: Sensorless contact forces estimation for robotic manipulators using dual-stage temporal-residual neural network compensation
publications.summary: A hybrid model estimates end-effector contact forces and moments from robot signals. Two stages of temporal-residual learning compensate dynamics errors and remaining wrench errors, with uncertainty estimates and experimental comparisons.

publications.name: Optimal Trajectory Generation and Feedback Tension Control of a Robotic Space Tether Launching System
publications.publisher: 2025 IEEE 11th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
publications.summary: A robotic arm accelerates and launches a tethered payload. Nonlinear modeling includes distributed tether mass and directional tension coupling; optimized feedforward motion and tension feedback are evaluated in simulation for accurate payload delivery.

publications.name: Optimal-transport-based geometry modeling for material extrusion additive manufacturing
publications.summary: An optimal-transport model describes how a moving nozzle reshapes extruded material. Two- and three-dimensional formulations predict line and corner profiles while considering viscous resistance, gravity, and changes in surface geometry.

publications.name: Cable-driven parallel robot trajectory generation with optimized orientation considering disturbance rejection
publications.summary: An analytical disturbance-sensitivity framework supports orientation optimization for a cable-driven parallel robot. The resulting anti-disturbance trajectory generator improves directional stiffness and nozzle tracking in simulations and gust experiments on a six-degree-of-freedom printing prototype.

publications.name: Design, Manufacturing, and Control of a Cable-Driven Bionic Robotic Hand
publications.publisher: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Biomimetics (ROBIO)
publications.summary: A cable-driven bionic robotic hand combines a lightweight mechanical design with coordinated control. Workspace, grasping, and free-space motion experiments evaluate its performance.

publications.name: In-situ additive manufacturing deposition trajectory monitoring and compensation with thermal camera
publications.summary: Thermal images track deposited geometry during material extrusion. Feature localization and deposition-direction alignment support dynamic extrusion-rate compensation to improve printing accuracy around corners.

publications.name: Design, Manufacturing, Modelling, and Control of a Cable-Driven Parallel Robot for Additive Manufacturing
publications.publisher: 2023 IEEE 19th International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE)
publications.summary: A six-degree-of-freedom cable-driven robot prototype supports additive manufacturing. A compensation method accounts for cable tension and positioning errors, with experimental verification of tracking and printing performance.

publications.name: Simulated annealing wrapped generic ensemble fault diagnostic strategy for VRF system
publications.summary: An ensemble approach combines simulated-annealing-based feature selection and multiple learners to diagnose refrigerant charge, valve, and compressor faults in variable refrigerant flow systems.
